import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { track } from "../../../backend/schema/track";

export const trackCms = customizeTable<typeof track>("track", {
    display: {
        title: "name"
    },
    listFields: ["trackId", "name", "composer", "milliseconds", "bytes", "unitPrice"],
    fieldOrder: [
        "trackId",
        "name",
        "composer",
        "milliseconds",
        "bytes",
        "unitPrice",
        "album",
        "mediaType",
        "genre"
    ]
});
